messages.content:
Describe the FINAL STATE of EACH file parameter. Make one tool call.
unchanged = keep this existing file and its bytes.
absent = this file must NOT exist afterward.
present = require existence only, with no byte condition.
initial:NAME = final bytes must equal the ORIGINAL bytes of parameter NAME.
Use initial:NAME for exact byte duplication, not for encryption or transformation.
Read explicit keep/remove conditions carefully. A request saying a file must not exist means absent.
Return states for ALL parameters. Other files and folders will be preserved by the backend.
Use ask_user only for ambiguous or unsupported effects: encryption, content transformations, processes, network, numeric results.
A trusted caller reviews this draft before any execution.
